findings.title: FirstLaunch handoff never publishes the existing Match route
findings.reproduction: Clear app data; choose English and Full guidance; complete FirstLaunch; observe the loading cover indefinitely; cold restart and observe ResumeHandoff with the same cover.
findings.cause: FirstLaunchNarrativeShellCompositionSystemHelper persisted EnterMission/HandoffPending without adding the existing UiShellRouteIntent.EnterMatch request, so the existing Match lifecycle owner never loaded the Match world.
findings.response: Publish exactly one existing EnterMatch/Match route request from the existing handoff boundary, guarded by handoffPublished.
findings.closureEvidence: Samsung replay logged deferred Match scene/gameplay requests and LoadingGate gameplayInitialized=1 playRequested=1 simulationActive=1

findings.title: Production never projects the M01 catalog or correlated logical map
findings.reproduction: Install the first corrected APK; clear app data; choose English and Full guidance; complete FirstLaunch; observe live Match start under an indefinitely retained FL-P18 final presentation.
findings.cause: CampaignMissionCatalogProjection had test-only callers. Production therefore had no campaign mission root/catalog or logical M01 operation-map metadata, so the typed launch could not be accepted after Match loaded.
findings.response: Project the already-authored M01 mission/scenario/Chapter01 map catalog from a bounded Menu runtime and let the existing Match map bootstrap reuse that logical metadata only for exact mission/scenario/map/source correlation while loading the unchanged compatibility physical source.
findings.closureEvidence: Exact squad-tray-correction APK source 89c328d7dafc2064afdd078dd76bb4b8093c4e38 installed on canonical Samsung and reached live M01 through Full FirstLaunch plus Contextual and Minimal settings/replay routes; Campaign briefing and live replay frames are recorded in the capture manifest

findings.title: M01 HUD exposes disabled economy, build, and support features
findings.reproduction: Launch M01 from Campaign on the canonical Samsung; reach the live tactical HUD; observe Materials, Oil, Fuel, BUILD, and SUPPORT despite the mission-definition restriction flags.
findings.cause: The shared Match HUD projected unrestricted Skirmish presentation and did not consume the active Campaign mission-definition restrictions.
findings.response: Project authoritative restriction flags read-only through an optional UI gateway; hide economy slots and disable their exchange action, hide BUILD/SUPPORT, preserve Civilian Risk, zoom, tactical commands, and Skirmish defaults.

findings.title: Live mission facts never observe patrol destruction or settle victory
findings.reproduction: Install exact source 89c328d7dafc2064afdd078dd76bb4b8093c4e38 on canonical Samsung; launch M01 from Campaign with Minimal guidance and replay tutorial off; destroy all three hostile patrol members; observe every red minimap marker disappear, then wait indefinitely while the live HUD remains and no result/debrief appears.
findings.cause: CampaignMissionSpawnSystem initializes CampaignMissionAttemptFactsComponent, but no production path updates elapsed time, move/threat/attack facts, command-squad survival/losses, or HostileDefeatedCount from the already-tagged live mission units. CampaignMissionRuntimeSystem therefore never sees the existing Engage-to-SecureCorridor victory predicate.
findings.owner: CampaignMissionRuntimeSystem (sole attempt-facts and mission phase/outcome writer)
findings.response: After existing movement/combat/death systems, sample only the active session's CampaignMissionUnitRoleComponent entities and monotonically project existing attempt facts from authoritative health/faction/position/command state plus the authored move-target anchor; preserve the existing phase/outcome/result/progress owners.

findings.title: Day/night progression makes active M01 combat near-black
findings.reproduction: Install exact source 6068e8c8f2882c726a6c791cf26c87b63adbb7eb on canonical Samsung; launch Campaign M01; continue real-input combat as the shared day/night presentation advances; observe the battlefield and units become materially unreadable while the HUD remains visible.
findings.cause: The shared DayNightSystem remained enabled for an active mission, so a bounded first-gameplay route could advance into near-black lighting despite M01's fixed readability and pacing contract.
findings.response: Apply the existing DayNightSystem runtime-visual boundary once when the authoritative active operation map or mission runtime carries a mission identity; keep the no-mission and Skirmish default enabled.
